content: This user's core network requirement is stable, maximum speed access (including browser performance) via dynamic node/channel switching, implemented via a long-term multi-exit acceleration architecture: rooted Magisk phone runs mihomo at /data/adb/mihomo_netbird (with DNS port 5354), paired with a host running mihomo, Tailscale, and NetBird. Host mihomo strategy groups and rules are core routing logic for this architecture and must be fully reviewed before designing acceleration optimizations.
